components.list_tables: List every table in the database with its column count. Start here when you don't yet know what exists.
components.describe_table: Show a table's columns, types, nullability, row count, primary key and foreign keys. Call this before writing SQL against a table — column names are frequently not what you'd guess.
components.sample_column: Show distinct values from a column, plus how many rows are null. Call this when a column's meaning affects the answer — how many rows are populated is often the difference between a column that exists and a convention the data actually follows.
components.count_distinct: Count rows per distinct value in a column, most frequent first. Use it to see the real shape of a categorical column.
